exclusions.source_text: Participants age ≥18 at time of informed consent
Eastern Cooperative Oncology Group Performance Status (ECOG PS) 0-1
i. estimated glomerular filtration rate \>30 mL/min calculated using the modification of diet in renal disease equation or CKD-EPI formula
i. Total bilirubin \< or = ULN ii. Alanine aminotransferase (ALT) \< or = ULN iii. Aspartate aminotransferase (AST) \< or = ULN
Participants who are positive for human immunodeficiency virus (HIV) must have a viral load below the limits of detection and on stable antiretroviral therapy for at least 3 months prior to C1D1.
Other malignancy within 3 years of signing ICF, except for skin cancer
Females who are pregnant, breastfeeding or planning to become pregnant within 6 months after the last dose of TYRA-300
History of or current uncontrolled cardiovascular disease
History of prolonged QT syndrome or baseline heart rate-corrected QT interval using Fridericia formula (QTcF) interval \>470 ms
Serum phosphate levels above the upper limit of normal during screening
